field_of_view_deg: PTZ 3.7-77 horizontal / 2.2-44 vertical; multi 97 horizontal / 71 vertical (per sensor)
features: 4x 5MP 1/2.7" multi-directional fixed sensors (each 3.2mm F2.0, 97 deg horizontal FoV) — independently adjustable tilt 40 +/-7 deg
2MP (1080p) 21x optical zoom PTZ head (4.0-84.6mm, F1.6-F4.5, motorized zoom/focus), up to 31x extra zoom
360 deg endless panning; tilt -15 to +195 deg
pan/tilt manual speed 0.065-150 deg/s, preset speed up to 500 deg/s; 256 preset positions
up to 6 Edge AI analytics apps: AI VMD, AI Privacy Guard, AI Face Detection, AI People Detection, AI Vehicle Detection, AI Non-mask Detection, AI Occupancy Detection, AI Scene Change Detection
AI Sound Classification (gunshot, yell, vehicle horn, glass break)
Super Dynamic WDR up to 144 dB (PTZ) / 108 dB (multi)
built-in FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified SecureElement (NXP EdgeLock SE050F)
GlobalSign device certificate pre-installed, alteration detection, 802.1X
IP66/IP67, IK10, NEMA 4X / Type 4X, wind resistance up to 40 m/s
dual IP address (one network interface) — may require 2 VMS licenses

frigate.notes: i-PRO RTSP: /Src/MediaInput/stream_1 (main) and /Src/MediaInput/stream_2 (sub). This model exposes the 4 fixed multi-directional sensors AND the PTZ head as SEPARATE channels — address each channel via /Src/MediaInput/stream_1/ch_N (ch_1..ch_4 = fixed sensors, ch_5 = PTZ). Note the camera presents 2 IP addresses on one NIC, so multi and PTZ heads may sit on different IPs. Use the substream (640x360) for the detect role at 5 fps.

home_assistant.notes: i-PRO; ONVIF Profile G/M/S/T. Add each channel (4 fixed + PTZ) separately; camera uses 2 IP addresses on a single network interface.

blue_iris.notes: Use the generic ONVIF profile; add the 4 fixed sensor channels and the PTZ channel individually. Camera exposes 2 IP addresses.
